tasks.brief: A small SaaS needs a pricing page
tasks.task: Write the React component for a 3-tier pricing table with a monthly/yearly toggle
acceptance: Three plans rendered from a data array, not hard-coded JSX
Toggle switches prices without page reload
Keyboard accessible: toggle and buttons reachable by Tab, visible focus

tasks.brief: Marketing wants a hero section that loads fast on mobile
tasks.task: Write the HTML and CSS for a responsive hero with headline, subtext, CTA and an image
acceptance: No layout shift: image has explicit width/height
Readable at 360px wide without horizontal scroll

tasks.brief: Internal dashboard shows a list of 10k rows and feels slow
tasks.task: Explain and implement a fix for rendering a 10k-row table in React
acceptance: Names the root cause (rendering every row)
Uses virtualization or pagination with code
States how to measure the improvement
